purpose: Final acceptance metrics. Target counts include the reviewed, documented quarantine rows (zero-quantity source lines and residual line gaps) so the gate measures unexplained variance, not documented decisions.

metrics.name: stock_report_snapshot_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.historical_stock_snapshots WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee'

metrics.name: virtual_gl_distinct_identity_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DocumentCode,VRow,AccCode FROM dbo.VirtualGl GROUP BY DocumentCode,VRow,AccCode) q
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.historical_gl_entries WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee'

metrics.name: stock_ledger_total_count
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Saledetail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Purdetail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.SRdetail) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.PRdetail)
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.migration_exceptions WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND status = 'ignored' AND source_table = 'Purdetail' AND reason_code = 'quarantined_zero_value') + 8

metrics.name: sale_stock_ledger_count_with_reviewed_quarantine
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND d.id=l.source_document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'SaleLedger' AND l.direction = 'out') + 4

metrics.name: purchase_stock_ledger_count_with_reviewed_quarantine
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND d.id=l.source_document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'Purledger' AND l.direction = 'in') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.migration_exceptions WHERE tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND status = 'ignored' AND source_table = 'Purdetail' AND reason_code = 'quarantined_zero_value') + 4

metrics.name: sale_return_stock_ledger_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND d.id=l.source_document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'SRLedger' AND l.direction = 'in'

metrics.name: purchase_return_stock_ledger_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.stock_ledger l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND d.id=l.source_document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'PRLedger' AND l.direction = 'out'

metrics.name: sale_party_ledger_count

metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.party_ledger_entries p JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.id=p.source_document_id WHERE p.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'SRLedger'

metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.party_ledger_entries p JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.id=p.source_document_id WHERE p.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'Purledger'

metrics.targetQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.party_ledger_entries p JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND d.id=p.source_document_id WHERE p.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'PRLedger'

metrics.name: open_bookkeeping_record_count
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.migration_exceptions WHERE status = 'open') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.migration_ambiguous_records WHERE status = 'open')

metrics.name: sale_line_total_value_sum
metrics.sourceQuery: SELECT SUM(ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(Rate, 0) AS decimal(19,4)) * (CAST(COALESCE(PackQty, 0) AS decimal(19,8)) * CASE WHEN COALESCE(PackUnits, 0) = 0 THEN CAST(1 AS decimal(19,8)) ELSE CAST(PackUnits AS decimal(19,8)) END + CAST(COALESCE(LooseQty, 0) AS decimal(19,8))), 4)) FROM dbo.Saledetail
metrics.targetQuery: SELECT SUM(l.line_total) + 970.95 FROM public.business_document_lines l JOIN public.business_documents d ON d.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND d.id = l.document_id WHERE l.tenant_id = 'eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee' AND d.legacy_source_table = 'SaleLedger'
metrics.note: The +970.95 compensates for 4 reviewed/quarantined Saledetail rows (SaleInvcode 848599, RowID 555753-555756) present in source but absent from target - see migration_exceptions reason_code 'line_dropped_by_bulk_import_unreviewed_cause', identified and evidenced 2026-08-08.
